== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 29 March 2026. The Facebook photo viewer names Robert Hallaman Jr. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 53 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (St Louis, Mo). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/Robbathehutt (House Springs, Missouri; from St. Louis; Fox Senior High class of 1992).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Robert Hallaman portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Robert Hallaman Facebook portrait.jpg]].
